history.action: 🔬 CONTAINER SECURITY & ISOLATION PATTERNS (C1225) — Created docs/research/container-security-isolation-patterns-c1225.md for Sprint 3 Day 5-7 managed execution (#189). reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Identifying security gap in existing specs — C1216 covers warm pools but not isolation/security patterns. Lesson: L716 — SaaS container isolation specs should address threat model, industry patterns, runtime selection (gVisor vs Firecracker), secrets injection, and network egress before implementation begins.
